name: Coordinate Interval Capacity of the Spectral Maximum Class
scope: Coordinate $2$ in the stored five-coordinate encoding; the equality is between suprema and does not assert attainment.
proof: For every realizing cone, three rooted rows and the exclusive words $14,16,1$ give $W_2\le\min\{s+t,1/s,1/t\}\le\sqrt2$. The interval comparison and $\tau(C_\ast)=2^{-1/4}$ give the matching lower bound.
